moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] is raised.
Deactivation Condition:
Cannot be deactivated.

Never misses. Leaves the target confused. Lowers one of the target’s stats (Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed, accuracy, or evasiveness) by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ] at random the following number of times:
[Digit:1digit Idx="2" ] [EN:Qty Ref="2" S="time" P="times" ] regardless of the status of the allied field of play, [Digit:1digit Idx="3" ] additional [EN:Qty Ref="3" S="time" P="times" ] when the Physical Damage Reduction effect applies to the allied field of play, [Digit:1digit Idx="4" ] additional [EN:Qty Ref="4" S="time" P="times" ] when the Special Damage Reduction effect applies to the allied field of play.

moves.name:
Almighty
Psychic
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When your team’s sync pair uses a sync move once.
Deactivation Condition:
Cannot be deactivated.

Never misses. The more the target’s stats are lowered, the greater the power of this attack. Has a chance ([Digit:2digits Idx="1" ]%) of lowering the target’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="3" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="3" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. The power and chance of applying additional effects of this move are not lowered even if there are multiple targets. Turns the field of play’s terrain into [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] the first time this attack move is successful each battle.

moves.name:
Prescient
Divine Psywave
moves.description:
Become Mega Alakazam until the end of battle. Applies [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="9" ] to the allied field of play the first time the user’s sync move is used each battle.
[Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="9" ] grants all of the following effects: Powers up the special attack moves and special sync moves of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits ]%. Reduces special attack move and special sync move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ]%. The more sync pairs with [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] that are on the allied field of play, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves and sync moves by [Digit:2digits Idx="3" ]% and reduces damage by [Digit:1digit Idx="4" ]%. The maximum power-up is [Digit:2digits Idx="5" ]%, and the maximum damage reduction is [Digit:2digits Idx="6" ]%.)

passives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits ]%. Reduces attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits Idx="1" ]%. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by 10% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is [Digit:2digits Idx="3" ]%, and the maximum damage reduction is [Digit:2digits Idx="4" ]%.)
